notes.headline: Binance hot wallets drained. Here is where it is going.
context: Binance Hot Wallet 14 is EIP-7702 delegated to a contract the attacker deployed hours earlier. That is how a single transaction emptied it.

Tether, Circle, Paxos, Ripple, World Liberty, First Digital and Binance (wBETH) have frozen about $2.8B of the attacker's tokens (each checked onchain). The attacker is racing to swap the rest into ETH and TRX, which cannot be frozen.

timeline.text: Signer 0x7C86…5CA0 gets 0.3 ETH in three 0.1 ETH withdrawals from Tornado Cash.
The signer deploys an earlier contract, 0x19bee294 (likely a test run).

The same signer deploys contract 0x63e842b0, about 4 hours before the drain. Binance Hot Wallet 14 is now EIP-7702 delegated to this contract (checked onchain), which is how one transaction could empty it.
Binance's BTC hot wallet sends 18,270 BTC ($1.44B) to bc1q0mtc…2mnm. It is split into 1,000 BTC chunks across about 19 new addresses, and none of it has moved since.
970,537 SOL ($94M) goes from Binance to AffzFD…BEaU on Solana.
First pulls from Binance wallets on Base and Optimism.
Binance's Tron hot wallet sends 612.7M USDT and 46.4M TRX to TG5i…wzsGi.
The big one: one transaction, sent by the Tornado-funded signer, empties Binance Hot Wallet 14 into 0x5227…2f8c. That is 64 tokens, $2.54B.
More Binance hot wallets send $1.06B, including 780M USDC, plus funds on Arbitrum and Avalanche.
500M USDT split to 0x9749 and 200M USDT to 0x0Ddf. Address-poisoning spam starts within minutes.
325M USDT swapped to 122,316 ETH on Uniswap and 1inch.
Tron: 300M USDT to TPBk, 234M swapped to 639M TRX on SUN.io.
Freezes: Tether freezes 971M USDT and Circle 823M USDC in 0x5227; Tether freezes 312.7M + 66M USDT on Tron.
A relay of fresh wallets (0x8d53, 0x77ED, 0x7Aa4) swaps $100M+ more USDT to ETH and sends $161M on to 0xCcBE.
29,934 wBETH and 217.5M ENA ($116M) moved from the main wallet to 0x7f9D…15E3.
Hot Wallet 14 sends another 200.4M USDT to the main wallet. The wallet is still delegated to the attacker's contract, so new funds landing in it get swept. That USDT is frozen on arrival.
The attacker spreads ETH, PEPE, AAVE, UNI and AVAX across 10+ fresh wallets. All of 0x9749's ETH (122,310 ETH, $278M) moves to 0xc887.
$13.2M of WBTC moves from the main wallet to 0xB3dd and is swapped to ETH on Uniswap.
Tron: all 46.4M TRX ($16.4M) moves from TG5i to a new wallet, TRBd…2PRki. The frozen USDT stays behind.
The attacker starts selling altcoins from the main wallet. ZAMA ($5.9M), ZRO ($5.3M) and RSR ($4.7M) each go to a fresh wallet and are sold for ETH on Uniswap.
Arbitrum Security Council freezes about $30.5M: it moves 74.6M ARB and 8,426 ETH from 0x3E2b to 0x…0DA0 (tx 0xb69c8177…).

First bridge cash-out: 0x554D swaps 200k AVAX for 1.56M USDC on Avalanche and burns it through Circle's CCTP bridge. It is minted at 23:27 to 0xc39e on Ethereum, and Circle has frozen that address (checked onchain).
Tether also froze the main wallet's 8.41M USDt on Avalanche and 6.2M USDT0 on Polygon (checked onchain).
Tron: two parcels of about $600k TRX keep hopping through new wallets every 15–20 min (15+ hops so far), probably testing a cash-out route. The tracker stops following them after hop 8.
17,260 ETH ($38.8M) moves from the main wallet to a new wallet, 0x03b0…20ea, where it sits for now.

Tron wallet TRBd sent out all its TRX (about $16M) in $600k–$1.4M parcels and is now empty. The TRX is split into uneven amounts and shuffled across many new wallets, some of them reused attacker hops. Arkham shows no exchange deposit yet.
The big Tron TRX stash starts moving: TSpe (about $229M of TRX) splits into 5 new wallets of $40–53M each. No exchange deposit yet.
A second sweep from the still-delegated Hot Wallet 14: about 100 smaller tokens (ARKM, STRK, GRT, POL, CHZ…), about $38M in all, go to 0xA97b. Found via Arkham's attacker profile.
Avalanche: 0x8035 sends $13.8M of AVAX to 0xaD45, which sells it for USDC through ParaSwap/Velora. The USDC goes to 0x1192… and moves on right away (not frozen).
That $2.7M of USDC is bridged from Avalanche to Ethereum through Circle's CCTP (not frozen this time), swapped to ETH, and sent to 0x2948…, which has already moved it on.
Tron wallet TRBd is refilled with about 101M TRX ($34M), so the attacker is gathering TRX back into one hub wallet.

More issuer freezes confirmed onchain: XAUt, PAXG, USD1, FDUSD, WLFI and others in the main wallet, wBETH in 0x7f9D (Binance) and RLUSD in 0xE702 (Ripple). Frozen total is now about $2.81B (tip from the community).

Tron hub TRBd is being emptied in small TRX parcels ($50k–150k each) to dozens of new wallets, and then on to older busy Tron wallets. TRBd went from about $23M to $6M. No exchange is labelled on these wallets yet. The map now shows these parcels as "Split to N small wallets" bubbles.
The main wallet sends 44.2M OP (about $5.4M) on Optimism to a new wallet, 0x6B1B. It is still there.
Tron wallet TL2F moves about $39M of TRX into the hub TRBd, after TRBd was almost empty from the small-parcel split. The money is still with the attacker.

The long-tail sweep wallet 0xA97b sells about $17M of small tokens on Uniswap and SushiSwap, into ETH and stablecoins. Nothing goes to an exchange. (Found late on 31 Oct: a tracker bug hid these rows.)

Aave unfroze its markets on 30 Oct, and USDT now has 0% LTV. The attacker's Aave position at 0x8d53 (60M USDT supplied, 19.8k WETH borrowed) has a health factor of 1.05: it gets liquidated if ETH rises about 5% (to about $2,365).
The main wallet starts selling long-tail tokens: about $5.3M of PROM on Uniswap, then ZAMA ($3.5M) and SOPH ($3.6M) sent to two new wallets that sell them on Uniswap. No exchange cash-out.

One token per new wallet, sold on Uniswap: SOPH sold for about $2.0M of ETH and ZAMA for about $2.2M, with heavy slippage. NIL ($2.7M), INNBC ($2.4M) and LSK ($2.1M) are sent to three more seller wallets.

First cash-outs, all from Tron: about $6.8M of USDT and TRX is paid into older third-party wallets (OTC desks or services, busy since before the drain), which then deposit to Poloniex and others. Direct deposits: $1.4M through Chainflip, $0.9M to OKX, $0.1M to HTX. About $9.3M in total.
Tron wallet TCBA moves about $39M of TRX into the hub TRBd, the same refill pattern as TL2F earlier. TRBd keeps sending small parcels out.
More one-token seller wallets: FUN ($1.8M) and RE ($1.3M, sold on Uniswap). The ETH from the sales gathers in 0xC209 ($13M).

VIRTUAL ($2.8M) goes to a new seller wallet 0x1186 and is sold on DODO and Velora for ETH, which is bridged by Stargate in small parts and then sent to 0xC209. 0xC209 now holds about $16M of ETH from the token sales.
More one-token seller wallets from the long-tail sweep: ENSO ($0.9M, sold on Uniswap) and FF ($0.8M).
The main wallet sends about $0.4M of PUNDIX to a Binance address.
Four more one-token seller wallets from the long-tail sweep: OPEN, ZBT, Auction and SAHARA (about $0.6M each). Auction and SAHARA are already sold on Uniswap.
Tron wallet TJaj moves about $38M of TRX into the hub TRBd: the third refill, after TL2F and TCBA. Each refill is then sent out in small parcels over about 6 hours.

New cash-out route on Tron: the hub TRBd sends TRX to TNhpfK, which deposits it into the JustLend TRX vault and redeems it to fresh wallets (this breaks the direct trail). The fresh wallets swap TRX to USDT on SUN.io and bridge the USDT off Tron with Relay.link. About $25M went through the vault today, and at least $9M has left by Relay.link so far.
Fourth refill: Tron wallet TKkH moves about $48.7M of TRX into the hub TRBd. The vault and Relay.link route continues: 9 fresh wallets have now bridged about $24M of USDT off Tron.

The long-tail seller wallets send their ETH to two collector wallets: 0xC209 (about $16M) and 0x8d4b (about 9,700 ETH, about $22M). Neither has moved its ETH. The vault and Relay.link route on Tron continues: about $24M bridged out so far.

Some small TRX parcels from the Tron hubs take another route: through 1–2 fresh wallets, then a swap to USDT on the Bitget Wallet swap router, with the USDT sent to another fresh wallet. About $7M in 16 swaps: 7 on 30 Oct and 9 since 31 Oct 20:00 (latest: $0.9M at 05:53 on 1 Nov). One trail leads to a busy unlabeled Tron wallet (TRt9ft) that pays out to many addresses.
First move of the Solana funds: the SOL wallet Affz sent 485,270 SOL (about $46M), half its balance, to a fresh unlabeled wallet (Eze86) after a 7 SOL test at 09:38. Eze86 still holds it all.

A second Solana route: Affz drips SOL to a fresh wallet (7SDu), about 17,700 SOL so far. 7SDu splits it into 500 SOL parcels for many fresh wallets, and those wallets paid into the Relay.link bridge: 26 deposits, 12,296 SOL (about $1.15M), from 10:12 to 15:07 UTC. About 13,200 SOL (~$1.3M) has left 7SDu; the last two parcels moved one hop further and are still being traced.

A third Solana route: Affz sends SOL to fresh wallets, about 53,000 SOL (about $5.0M) so far, and they swap almost all of it on Jupiter: about 47,000 SOL into USDC, which goes on to more fresh wallets, for example $1.28M to Hcdf48 at 07:14. One batch of 6,200 SOL was split across 11 new wallets at 10:32 to 10:40, merged back into one wallet by 10:41, then swapped at 10:46. The USDC is still being traced. Affz now holds about 413,000 SOL.
The long-tail sweep wallet 0xA97b sent about $0.47M of GALA to a Binance-labeled address.

Affz speeds up again: about 180,000 SOL (about $17M) out in 16 hours, in bigger batches. Each batch goes to a fresh wallet, then one more hop, then splits into 10 to 12 wallets of 600 to 2,600 SOL each (for example 14,036 SOL via H381HE and HssTWZ at 01:43, and 6,460 SOL via GadT2M and C27zpB at 03:25). These wallets then split again into parcels of 100 to 400 SOL.
Parcel wallet 2qvUZB swaps 6,459 SOL (about $0.6M) on Jupiter in two trades. The tracker found it only at 13:30, when it first read this wallet.
A fourth Solana route: wallet UefNb6 swaps at least 2,274 SOL in Raydium and Meteora pools, using a router not seen before. More of its swaps are still being read.

First use of a mixer: wallets fed from Affz (mainly HSze3V and HVxuFQ) send about 11,250 SOL (about $1.04M) into the Privacy Cash pool on Solana, in 32 deposits of 10 to 4,200 SOL. After this the funds cannot be followed.
More Jupiter swaps: about 16,600 SOL (about $1.5M) swapped, mostly by 71JD6x (6,629 SOL) and 9aB9pN (6,415 SOL).

Eze86 sends 240,000 SOL (about $22M) back to Affz in one transfer, leaving about 245,000 SOL in Eze86. This is a move between the drainer's own wallets, not an exit. Affz now holds about 474,000 SOL to spend from.
